# bintables/int

> Integer literal: loads the value into rax.

truck [bintables](../bintables.md) · [source](../../../registry/bintables/int.pkg)

Any 64-bit value is allowed. Packages that can use an integer directly as
an operand (`when right simple`) skip this package for small values.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit`

```nasm
mov rax, {value}
```
